## 8.4 Measurement and monitoring

Every Board-level appetite statement is supported by at least one quantitative measure with a defined limit, tolerance band, measurement basis, data source, named owner and reporting frequency. The consolidated position is reported to the Group Executive Risk Committee monthly and to the Board Risk Committee quarterly.

## 8.5 Appetite and Ili breaches

Abreach exists when a measure moves outside its approved limit,irrespectiveofduration or of whether it self-corrected.Breaches are not netted, are not resolved by retrospective limit increases, and are reported in the period in which they occurred.

| BREACHTYPE | DEFINITION | NOTIFICATION | REOUIREDRESPONSE |
|---|---|---|---|
| Trigger breach | Early-warning threshold reached,limitnotbreached | Divisionalrisk function,sameday | Management action plan within 5 business days |
| Tolerance breach | Outsidethetolerance band but within the limit | Group ExecutiveRiskCommitteeat next meeting | Documentedplantoreturnwithintolerance,withtarget date |
| Limit breach | Outside the approved limit | M.T.Achebewithin24hours (+1212 555-0147):BoardRiskCommitteeat nextmeeting | Immediateremediationplan;consideration oftrading or origination restrictions |
| Zero-appetitebreach | Any occurrence in a zero- appetite category | M.TAchebeandEL.Nakagawa immediately:BoardRisk within 5business davs | Incidentinvestigation,rootcauseanalysis,disciplinaryand |

Prohibited practice. Limits must not be amended to cure «im existing breach. Any limit change proposed within thirty days of a breach of that limit requires explicit Board Risk Committee approval, and the Committee must be provided with the breach history alongside the proposal.

## 8.7 Cascading appetite to the business

Group appetite is cascaded to divisions, and from divisions to business units, desks and portfolios. The sum of cascaded limits may be less than the Group limit but may never exceed it. Divisional limits are approved by the Group Executive Risk Committee and reviewed whenever Group appetite changes. Each business unit head must demonstrate the line of sight from local limits to the Board-approved statement.

## 8.8 Linking appetite to reward

Adherence to appetite is a mandatory input to performance assessment for all material risk takers. The Remuneration Committee receives elm annual risk conduct report from the Group CRO covering appetite breaches, unremediated overdue issues, Critical incidents and audit findings attributable to each named individual. The Committee may apply in-year adjustment, malus or clawback where risk outcomes warrant it. A favourable financial result achieved outside appetite is not a basis for reward.
